text: I was in a similar situation like your partner. I was coming and going to visit my partner in Israel. Sometimes also with shorter time away in-between the visits. Never had a problem. They always asked why I come and if I'm planning to live here and how I manage that with work. As long as you are not married and  she can honestly tell them that she lives in Switzerland and it's really just a visit, she will be fine I think. With marriage it might get more complicated because they think you would want to live together. That's based on my experience and how it was for me.
